newsitem.title: USA: Stericycle sees more acquisitions in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Stericycle sees more acquisitions in 1997.

text.p: Stericycle Inc said Tuesday the company expects to continue making acquisitions in 1997 amid consolidation in the medical waste industry.

"Acquisition opportunities remain robust within the medical waste market due to continuing industry consolidation pressures," Mark Miller, Stericycle president and chief executive, said in a statement. "We expect to remain active in acquiring attractive candidates in the year ahead."
Stericycle on Tuesday reported first quarter earnings of $0.01 a share, versus a net loss of $0.05 a share last year.
During the quarter, Miller said Stericycle completed the integration of Waste Managment Inc's medical waste operations and finalized the acquisition of Environmental Control Co Inc.
